description: B-I-N-G-O Clap Along (br17) models: a wooden toy letter block (a cube painted in its main colour with cream panels on every face, for a letter on the front) and a red dog collar with a gold name tag that fits the catalog dog (Bingo). The HUD clap icon is rhymes_br13.json `clap_icon`. Same format as ../models.json. Props face +z and stand on y = 0.

letter_block.description: A wooden toy alphabet block, a 0.5 m cube at size 1 with softly rounded edges, painted in its main colour (set color) with a raised cream panel 0.4 m square on the front, back, sides and top. Origin at the middle of its base; the front panel's face is at z = 0.27 (times size). Put the letter on the front as a separate letter object parented to it: at size 1.2 (a 0.6 m block) a letter of size 0.23 at [0, 0.14, 0.33] fills the panel (a child's at and size do not scale with the block).

dog_collar.description: A puppy's collar in its main colour (set color) with a gold buckle ring and a round gold name tag hanging at the front, sized for the catalog dog's neck. Parent it to a dog critter with part "head" at [0, -0.27, -0.03] (critter units, so it scales with the dog's size).
